text:
maya: FYI partners: we're planning a breaking change to the public SDK transport. v1 sync endpoints (/v1/generate) will be deprecated in favor of v2 streaming/structured responses with async websocket/HTTP2 semantics. This affects partner integrations that relied on one-shot sync calls and response envelopes. We need coordinated partner testing, marketplace listing updates, and a clear migration path.

jordi: How big is the break? Are we renaming endpoints or changing payloads? Partners need time to update connectors in marketplace listings.

maya: Both. Endpoint paths will change (/v1/generate -> /v2/stream) and the response shape will include an outer 'chunks' envelope with incremental tokens + final 'meta' block. Also we will require client to send an 'X-Redwood-Client-Mode: streaming' header for non-websocket fallbacks. Semver: major bump for SDKs.

tom: Ok. From marketplace PM side we need a compatibility flag and migration notes. Marketplace validators currently run an integration that posts to /v1/generate and expects a single JSON with 'text'. If we flip, validators fail. We need a staged transition mode where the service accepts both old and new payloads for 8 weeks.

rachel: On the SI/hardware side, a lot of our partners have long-lived AMI-based connectors that parse the old envelope. If we change the envelope, they'll break. We should provide shim libraries in the SDK that expose the old sync API but translate to streaming under the hood. That buys time without forcing immediate infra changes.

maya: Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) SDK shim that implements old sync methods by opening a short-lived websocket and aggregating chunks into the legacy single response; 2) release v2 SDKs with major bump (2.0.0) and a compatibility package redwood-legacy-sync that partners can opt into; 3) Marketplace validators added to accept both shapes during an 8-week migration; 4) Partner canaries (marketplace vendors + 3 SI partners) run tests in weeks 2-3; 5) public cutoff at week 9 with rollback plan.

jordi: Do we need to update legal / marketplace listing manifest? Some marketplaces require the SDK to declare breaking changes in the listing notes. I'll draft the notice if you give the migration window.

tom: CI wise, SDKs need new integration tests that exercise websocket fallback, HTTP2 streaming, and the shim. Also update our API lints that currently block unknown top-level fields. Tagging @deploy-bot to surface any failing tests.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued at 2224445588: sdk-canary/partners. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/2224445588

rachel: For SI partners we should provide example adapter patches. Sample shim usage to include in the one-pager: 

```
# legacy usage (old)
from redwood import generate
resp = generate(prompt="summarize this")
print(resp['text'])

# new usage (shim will allow old code)
pip install redwood-sdk==2.0.0 redwood-legacy-sync
# runtime will auto-detect and use websocket stream under the hood
```

maya: Also supply a small test harness for partners to run locally: a curl + websocket client that shows both behaviors and exit codes. We'll produce sample AMIs for SI partners that include the shim and test scripts.

jordi: Timeline OK: announce today, staged dual-accept for 8 weeks, partner canaries weeks 2-3, public cutoff at week 9. I'll prepare the marketplace notice and a short FAQ for listings.

tom: Action items: tom -> CI test matrix and API lints (due Thu), rachel -> create adapter patches + AMI smoke test (due Fri), maya -> build shim + migration docs (due Wed), jordi -> marketplace notice + partner email (due Tue).

maya: One more: telemetry. When shim translates streaming -> legacy, add a telemetry ping with migration_version so we can track who still uses shim. Non-identifying only. That helps schedule enforcement later.

rachel: Can we include a sample of the new chunked envelope in the docs? Example: 

```
{
  "chunks": [
    {"delta":"Hello"},
    {"delta":" world"}
  ],
  "meta": {"duration_ms":120, "model":"rw/3b"}
}
```

tom: Fine. Also plan for marketplace validators: if a vendor opts into legacy shim, we should mark their listing 'compat: legacy' so validators know to expect shim behavior. Jordi can coordinate listing metadata.

jordi: noted. I'll add a 'compatibility' field to the marketplace manifest and provide sample JSON for vendors.

maya: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread for the coordination log. Please post any canary failures here and tag @partners. Closing after tom posts updated CI jobs. :rocket:
